title: This Object Outshines 500 Trillion Suns and Swallows One Sun a Day

scenes.text: One object in space outshines five hundred trillion Suns.
It is a quasar, powered by a black hole.
That black hole is up to nineteen billion times the mass of our Sun.
It swallows roughly one whole Sun every single day.
It is twelve billion light years away, so we see it as it was long ago.
Astronomers once thought it was just a star.

description:
Astronomers found a quasar that is about 500 trillion times brighter than the Sun.
Its black hole swallows roughly one Sun's worth of matter every day. It is twelve billion light years away.
What would you name it?
first_comment: Would you fly toward it if you could?
